name: Georgette
description: Two dot fields at different pitches laid over each other, so the surface crinkles.

code.style: --rule: ( --rot: @pick(0deg, 90deg, 180deg, 270deg); @random(${shapeFrequency}) { background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-mask: radial-gradient(circle at 50% 50%, #000 20%, transparent 20%) 0 0 / 25% 25%, radial-gradient(circle at 50% 50%, #000 8%, transparent 8%) 0 0 / 12.5% 12.5%; mask: radial-gradient(circle at 50% 50%, #000 20%, transparent 20%) 0 0 / 25% 25%, radial-gradient(circle at 50% 50%, #000 8%, transparent 8%) 0 0 / 12.5% 12.5%; -webkit-transform: rotate(@var(--rot)); transform: rotate(@var(--rot)); } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
